_readme: Rotating fada'il (virtue) facts appended to the 'time to pray' notification for each of the 5 daily prayers. 'confirmed': true means the user has approved the wording.

fajr.text: The two rak'ahs before Fajr are better than this world and everything in it.
Whoever prays Fajr in congregation is under Allah's protection for that day.

dhuhr.text: Whoever prays four rak'ahs before Dhuhr and four after it, Allah forbids him from the Fire.

asr.text: Whoever misses the Asr prayer, it is as if he lost his family and his wealth.
Whoever prays the two 'cool' prayers, Fajr and Asr, will enter Paradise.

maghrib.text: The time between the adhan and the iqamah is a time when dua is not turned away, so ask Allah generously as you wait for Maghrib.
Hastening to pray Maghrib as soon as its time enters was the regular practice of the Prophet ﷺ and his companions.

isha.text: Whoever prays Isha in congregation, it is as if he had prayed half the night.
Isha and Fajr are the two prayers heaviest on the hypocrites, yet if people knew their true reward, they would come to them even crawling.
